name: Kagome no Mayu -Jutai no Ninpouchou-
source:
At first glance, the setting is an ordinary school. However, the school has a "Shinobi Group" that is only allowed to operate at night.

The protagonist, Kyoichi, was born into a ninja family and was one of the students in the "Shinobi Group". However, Kyoichi does not like his ninja bloodline and lives a careless student life...

One day, an incident occurs that shakes up this life. It is said that Mayuko, a girl whom Kyoichi has admired for a long time, is in danger. The mastermind behind this is the school's dean.

"Return to the Female Body" ---

A ninjutsu that has now become an illusion, and was no longer thought to exist. It seems that the school dean, who was on the verge of death, activated a secret technique called "to be reborn in this world while retaining the memories of his previous life.''

"A fetus with memories"...

Mayuko was chosen as the "mother" to give birth to this fetus. For Mayuko's sake, Kyouichi decides to become a "ninja", something he detests. Will Kyouichi be able to protect Mayuko?

Or will he....

"A fierce ninjutsu battle with the attacking assassins begins!"

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/kagome/story.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
乍一看，这是一所普通的学校。不过，学校里有一个只允许在夜间活动的“忍者团”。

主角恭一出生于忍者世家，是“忍者团”的学生之一。然而恭一并不喜欢自己的忍者血统，过着漫不经心的学生生活……

有一天，发生了一件震惊了生活的事件。据说恭一仰慕已久的女孩真由子正面临危险。这件事的幕后主使是该校的院长。

《回归女性身体》——

一种现在已经成为幻象、不再被认为存在的忍术。看来，濒临死亡的院长启动了一项名为“重生到这个世界，同时保留前世记忆”的秘术。

“有记忆的胎儿”……

真由子被选为“母亲”来生下这个胎儿。为了真由子，恭一决定成为一名他所厌恶的“忍者”。恭一能保护真由子吗？

或者他会……

“一场与来袭的刺客的激烈忍术战斗开始了！”

[翻译自[url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/kagome/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
